title: Π 形电阻二端口的 Y 参数
statement: 图示 Π 形电阻二端口中，R1 = 2 Ω，R2 = 5 Ω，R3 = 4 Ω。端口电压、电流取关联参考方向（电流从 1、2 端流入）。
Y 参数方程：i1 = y11·u1 + y12·u2，i2 = y21·u1 + y22·u2。按定义（令另一端口短路）求 Y 参数。

questions.explain: u2 = 0 时 R3 中电流 u1/4 从左向右流进短路线，经 2' 回去——它是从 2 端“流出”的，所以 i2 = −u1/4，y21 = −0.25 S。

questions.ask: 无源 Π 形网络的 y12（= y21）总是……
questions.explain: y12 = i1/u2（u1 = 0）：在 2 端加正电压，电流经 R3 流向 1 端、从 1 端流出到短路线，与 i1 的参考方向相反，所以 y12 = −1/R3 < 0。

hints: Y 参数又叫短路导纳参数：求 y11、y21 时令 u2 = 0（2–2' 短路），在 1–1' 加电压 u1。
端口被短路时，并在这个端口上的电阻被短接，不起作用；注意 i2 的参考方向是流入 2 端。
solution: **1. 令 u2 = 0（2–2' 短路），在 1–1' 加电压 u1。** R2 两端被短接；R1 和 R3 两端电压都是 u1：
R3 中电流 u1/4 流入短路线并从 2 端“流出”，i2 = −u1/4 → **y21 = −0.25 S**。

en.title: Y parameters of a resistive Π network
statement: In the resistive Π two-port, R1 = 2 Ω, R2 = 5 Ω, R3 = 4 Ω. Port voltages and currents follow the passive convention (currents flow into terminals 1 and 2).
Y-parameter equations: i1 = y11·v1 + y12·v2, i2 = y21·v1 + y22·v2. Find the Y parameters from their definitions (with the other port shorted).

questions.explain: With 2–2' shorted (v2 = 0), R2 is shorted out and both R1 and R3 have v1 across them: y11 = 1/2 + 1/4 = 0.75 S.
With v2 = 0 the current v1/4 in R3 flows left to right into the short and returns via 2' — it leaves terminal 2, so i2 = −v1/4 and y21 = −0.25 S.
With 1–1' shorted (v1 = 0), R1 is shorted out and port 2 sees R2 in parallel with R3: y22 = 1/5 + 1/4 = 0.45 S.

questions.ask: For a passive Π network, y12 (= y21) is always …
questions.explain: y12 = i1/v2 with v1 = 0: a positive voltage at port 2 drives current through R3 towards terminal 1 and out of it into the short, opposite to the reference direction of i1, so y12 = −1/R3 < 0.

hints: Y parameters are the short-circuit admittance parameters: for y11 and y21 set v2 = 0 (port 2 shorted) and drive port 1 with a voltage v1.
A resistor across a shorted port is shorted out and plays no part; remember that i2 is defined as flowing into terminal 2.
solution: **1. Set v2 = 0 (2–2' shorted) and drive port 1 with v1.** R2 is shorted out; R1 and R3 both have v1 across them:
the current v1/4 in R3 flows into the short and out of terminal 2, so i2 = −v1/4 → **y21 = −0.25 S**.
**2. Set v1 = 0 (1–1' shorted) and drive port 2 with v2.** Likewise i2 = v2/R2 + v2/R3 → **y22 = 0.45 S**, and i1 = −v2/R3 → y12 = −0.25 S.
**3. Result:** Y = [0.75 −0.25; −0.25 0.45] S. The Y parameters of a Π network can be read off directly: y11 = G1 + G3, y22 = G2 + G3, y12 = y21 = −G3.
